content: Diabetes distress, which is frequently linked to symptoms of anxiety and depression, should be routinely assessed using validated tools specifically designed for diabetes-related emotional health. These tools can be accessed through resources such as the American Diabetes Association’s mental health toolkit. If diabetes distress is identified during screening, it is essential to provide appropriate follow-up care. This may include offering diabetes education tailored to the individual’s needs or referring the patient to qualified behavioral health professionals for further support and intervention.
